m1.typescript: m1 a segment table reports accuracy and error cost with the costliest segment first

e1.typescript: e1 a segment with no cost entry costs one per error and no results give an empty table

e2.typescript: e2 a percentile uses the nearest rank and does not need sorted input

e3.typescript: e3 a test with fewer cases than the minimum in either arm decides nothing

e4.typescript: e4 a difference is called only when it clears the 95 percent bar and the better side is named

e5.typescript: e5 a shadow run is held for a regression in a protected segment or for more losses than gains

e6.typescript: e6 diagnosis checks the evidence then the grounding then the format then the stronger model

e7.typescript: e7 model choice takes the cheapest option that meets the accuracy floor and the latency limit

wrong-pct-truncated.defect: rounds an accuracy down instead of to the nearest whole percent

wrong-sorted-by-name.defect: orders the report by segment name and not by error cost

wrong-default-cost-zero.defect: makes the errors of a segment with no cost entry free

wrong-percentile-floor.defect: takes the rank rounded down, so the 95th percentile of four values is the third

wrong-percentile-unsorted.defect: reads the percentile from the values in the order they arrived

wrong-ab-min-ignored.defect: gives a verdict on a handful of cases

wrong-ab-always-new.defect: names the new version as better whenever it clears the bar, even when it is worse

wrong-ab-90-percent.defect: uses the 90 percent bar and calls a difference that could be chance

wrong-gate-net-only.defect: ships a version that lost a right answer in a protected segment because it gained as many elsewhere

wrong-gate-protected-only.defect: ships a version that lost more answers than it gained in segments that are not protected

wrong-diagnose-grounding-late.defect: checks the format before it asks whether the answer is supported by the evidence

wrong-choose-ignores-latency.defect: picks a model that is too slow because it meets the accuracy floor

wrong-choose-ties-by-order.defect: breaks a tie in cost by the order the options were listed
